newsitem.title: USA: TFC enters amended loan agreement.
newsitem.headline: TFC enters amended loan agreement.

text.p: TFC Enterprises Inc said Tuesday it had entered into an amended loan agreement with its primary lender, General Electric Capital Corp.

The amended agreement corrects out-of-compliance conditions that arose as of December 31, 1996, primarily as a result of a provision for credit losses recorded in the fourth quarter, the company said.

TFC said the new pact provides it with a $110 million credit line to December 31, 1998 -- reduced from $150 million previously -- and enables it to consolidate substantially all the debt under its term notes with NationsBank into the line of credit.

The agreement also grants GECC warrants to purchase a total of about 1.1 million shares of TFC common stock at $1 per share over a five-year period, including the previously announced 567,640 warrant shares granted GECC in December 1996, TFC said. The December warrant shares were priced originally at $2 each, it said.
GECC is a unit of General Electric Co.
